_comment: The selected compatibility checkpoint: which Claude Code release the edits are reviewed against, the exact prompt map and tweakcc pin that review used, and the pristine binary hashes tools/build_ab.py accepts. A dated observation, not a fleet poll; the per-machine state is TODO.md's machine table.

Replace the seeds per spec/45 'After upstream merges' if the merged blob differs. Round: notes/2026-11-10-macos-2.1.322.md.

tweakcc.containerGap: CC 2.1.310's shared bytecode slab needs tweakcc c44c88c3 (PR 1053, merged 2026-10-24, unreleased). This pin predates it, so assemble skips tweakcc's patch set on 2.1.310 and later (no in-CC banner). verifiedCcVersion stays 2.1.308 because the patch set has not run on 2.1.310.
